description:
Hi, I'm Rupali S. Rathore, a Certified Global Career Counsellor (UCLA Extension).
I help students and parents make informed academic and career decisions through personalized career counselling, scientific aptitude assessments, and expert guidance. From choosing the right stream and career path to higher education in India and abroad, my goal is to provide clarity, confidence, and the right direction at every stage of a student's journey.

Our Services:
• Career Counselling (Std. 8th–12th & above)
• Aptitude & Psychometric Assessments
• Multiple Intelligence, Personality & Learning Style Analysis
• NRI / PIO / OCI Admission Guidance
• Study Abroad Counselling & University Selection
• Personalized Career Roadmaps for Students

Every student has unique potential. Together, let's discover the path that's right for you
